name: Paris Katherine Jackson
role: Model, actress and singer; daughter of Michael Jackson
summary: Paris Jackson is an entertainer with no political office or programme. Her public political remarks are occasional: condemning neo-Nazis and white supremacists at the 2017 MTV VMAs and voicing support for the Dakota Access Pipeline protests at the 2017 Grammys. She has not stated positions on the policy questions in the test.
